name: Beach's days
source:
After an arrival on what seems to be a paradise island, between cocktail, palm tree and lightning strikes, nightmare fall upon you in the shade of the sun... A poisoning during a rather normal evening shaken the population of the island. What if your character let his heart hinder the investigation...? Maybe the mesmerizing eyes crossed across the dance floor on the night of the drama are not so innocent as it seems... Discover the real story during your Beach Days... 

[From [url=https://saalt.itch.io/beachs-days]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
踏上这座看似人间天堂的海岛后，在鸡尾酒、棕榈树与划破天际的闪电之间，一场噩梦在烈日投下的阴影中骤然降临……某个再寻常不过的夜晚发生了一起投毒案，震惊了全岛居民。倘若你的角色放任自己的感情干扰了案件调查，又会发生什么……？说不定案发当晚在舞池对岸与你四目相对的那双迷人眼眸，并不像表面看上去那样无辜……在这段海滩假日里，揭开埋藏在暗处的真相吧……

[摘自[url=https://saalt.itch.io/beachs-days]itch.io[/url]]
